Description: A panel targeting amyloid beta (Abeta) peptide species — including total Aβ or multiple isoforms (e.g. Abeta40, Abeta42) — commonly measured as biomarkers of amyloid pathology in Alzheimer's disease research.

A user-defined or study-specific panel not captured by a standard biological category. Contributors should provide additional documentation describing the panel targets, ideally using established identifiers such as UniProt IDs or HGNC gene symbols.
A panel targeting inflammatory mediators, including cytokines, chemokines, and other immune signaling proteins, used to characterize neuroinflammatory or systemic inflammatory states.
A panel targeting biomarkers of neurodegenerative disease (specifically: NfL, GFAP, total Tau)

A panel targeting serum amyloid A (SAA), an acute-phase apolipoprotein that can increase more than 1000-fold during acute inflammation and is studied as a biomarker in neurodegeneration, autoimmune diseases, and other inflammatory conditions.
A NULISASeq panel targeting 120+ neuro-specific and inflammatory proteins, including key biomarkers of amyloid and tau pathologies, synaptic function, neurodegeneration, and inflammation.
